scene.title: How Transverse Waves Move
scene.summary: A transverse wave travels horizontally while the medium’s particles oscillate up and down.

entities.text: Particles move perpendicular to wave direction

beats.title: Wave snapshot
beats.narration: A sine curve shows the shape of a transverse wave moving to the right.

beats.title: Particle oscillation
beats.narration: At several points the medium particles move up and down, shown by vertical arrows.

beats.title: Wave propagation
beats.narration: The wave travels rightward; the traveling dot follows the curve while each particle continues its up‑down motion.

beats.title: Key takeaway
beats.narration: Transverse waves transfer energy horizontally, but the medium’s particles only move vertically.
